data = open("R3圆形两轮差速小车底盘-3D模型.stp","rb").read().decode("gbk", errors="replace")
body = data.split("DATA;",1)[1]

for m in re.finditer(r"#(\d+)\s*=\s*([^;]*);", body):
    ent[int(m.group(1))] = m.group(2)

ref_re = re.compile(r"#(\d+)")
def closure(root):
    seen=set(); stack=[root]
    while stack:
        i=stack.pop()
        if i in seen: continue
        seen.add(i)
        for r in ref_re.findall(ent[i]): 
            r=int(r)
            if r not in seen: stack.append(r)
    return seen
pt_re = re.compile(r"CARTESIAN_POINT\s*\(\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*\(([-0-9.Ee+, ]+)\)")
breps = [4540,4836,6182,11639,11983,141108,146495,274979,275957]

import re
from collections import Counter
data = open("R3圆形两轮差速小车底盘-3D模型.stp","rb").read().decode("gbk", errors="replace")
body = data.split("DATA;",1)[1]

    ent[int(m.group(1))] = m.group(2)
ref_re = re.compile(r"#(\d+)")
def closure(root):
    seen=set(); stack=[root]
    while stack:
        i=stack.pop()
        if i in seen: continue

        for r in ref_re.findall(ent[i]):

    ent[int(m.group(1))] = m.group(2)
# CDSR -> RRWT(含 ITEM_DEFINED_TRANSFORMATION) -> 两个 AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D
def axis(i):
    m = re.match(r"AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D\s*\(\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*#(\d+)\s*,\s*#(\d+)\s*,\s*#(\d+)", ent[i])
    p = re.match(r"CARTESIAN_POINT\s*\(\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*\(([^)]*)\)", ent[int(m.group(1))]).group(1)
    z = re.match(r"DIRECTION\s*\(\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*\(([^)]*)\)", ent[int(m.group(2))]).group(1)
    return p, z
for m in re.finditer(r"#(\d+)\s*=\s*CONTEXT_DEPENDENT_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION\s*\(\s*#(\d+)\s*,\s*#(\d+)\s*\)", body):
    cdsr, rrwt_id = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
    # RRWT 是复合实体或普通实体
    t = ent[rrwt_id]
    rr = re.search(r"REPRESENTATION_RELATIONSHIP\s*\(\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*#(\d+)\s*,\s*#(\d+)", t)
    idt = re.search(r"ITEM_DEFINED_TRANSFORMATION\s*\(\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*#(\d+)\s*,\s*#(\d+)", t)
    if not idt:
        idtref = re.search(r"REPRESENTATION_RELATIONSHIP_WITH_TRANSFORMATION\s*\(\s*#(\d+)", t)
        idt = re.search(r"ITEM_DEFINED_TRANSFORMATION\s*\(\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*'[^']*'\s*,\s*#(\d+)\s*,\s*#(\d+)", ent[int(idtref.group(1))]) if idtref else None
    rep_pair = (rr.group(1), rr.group(2)) if rr else ("?","?")
    if idt:
        a1, a2 = int(idt.group(1)), int(idt.group(2))
        p1,z1 = axis(a1); p2,z2 = axis(a2)
        print(f"CDSR#{cdsr} rep {rep_pair[0]}->{rep_pair[1]}: 位置=({p2}) 轴向=({z2})")
    else:
        print(f"CDSR#{cdsr} rep {rep_pair}: 未解析到变换", t[:150])
